note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A). Every assert is derived by hand from the 32-wire topology and the printed rule on p.57 (LEFT = YES for A on switch 4, B on switch 5, C on switch 6; pushbutton 6 turns the knob to the number), not from a trace. The dial positions repeat the printed fixture VI-MINDREADING for four numbers (5, 2, 7, 0, in that order from the construction start); the derived content is: nothing lights, operates or moves with pushbutton 6 up (before the first push, and after a switch change at rest on 5); while pushbutton 6 is held, output lamps 4, 5, 6 show the answers (switch LEFT = lamp on, so the lamps read the number in binary), relays 5 and 6 and their indicator lamps follow switches 5 and 6, relay 4 and section 1-3 lamps and relays stay out; on release everything drops and the dial stays put. The page names no lamp or relay behaviour. The p.58 name variation is not scripted (its answers need outside knowledge). Rotation direction and run time are not asserted; each until allows 12 s. Digest is a placeholder for the runner.
